messages:
jess: final freeze reminder — we go into soft freeze in 3 hours (21:00 UTC). Please avoid non‑urgent merges. If you need a late merge, post the exception rationale and impact here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
omar: quick question — I have a tiny packaging fix (version bump in setup.py) that fixes pip install failure for a downstream integration. Docs-only otherwise. worth asking for exception?
jess: sounds small, but still counts. what's the delta? one line? any db/schema changes?
omar: only packaging metadata + changelog entry. no code path change. bump from 1.2.4 -> 1.2.5, and add the missing wheel classifier.
jess: OK please include exact commands & a reviewer. we prefer a cherry-pick to release branch and a canary deploy after merge.
mar: @liv is on watch for canary — liv you cool with a quick smoke?
liv: yep I can do canary verification within 15 mins of merge. fine as long as we gate by tag and don't touch infra.
kevin: @omar please tag with "late-exception" label in PR and add the following to PR description: rationale, rollback plan, smoke steps, owner.
omar: will do. draft PR in 2 min. pinging @sylvia for review — docs and packaging owner.
sylvia: on it. if it's truly just metadata + changelog I'm +1. commit message needs conventional format: "chore(release): 1.2.5 packaging fix"
omar: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8219 — title and body updated. label applied.
release-bot: automatic note: branch release/1.2.x is protected. merging requires at least 1 approving review and CI green.
jess: since this is a late exception, I'll approve merge after sylvia approves and CI passes. then we do canary on dev-cluster, monitor 10m, if green promote to prod. rollback plan: revert the cherry-pick commit and roll back tag.
sylvia: approved. CI flaky test flake-setup still unstable but not related to packaging. heads up.
omar: CI passed. merging now. command used:
```
# cherry-pick into release branch
git checkout release/1.2.x
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
git push origin release/1.2.x
```
liv: canary started on dev-cluster. smoke checklist: basic API health, install from wheel, run sample inference.
release-bot: canary deploy succeeded. all monitored metrics within expected bounds.
jess: looks good so far. waiting full 10m window.
kevin: recording this as a gated late-exception: packaging-only, low-risk, 1 reviewer, canary verified. please add the exception note to the release board.
omar: added note to release board with link to PR and canary logs.
jess: final promote to prod in 2 min. doing tag and release. thanks all. :tada:
release-bot: release tag v1.2.5 created and promoted to production.
jess: closing loop — exception approved, documented, and reverted plan in place in case anything breaks. great coordination.
